sections.headline: Your first prompt should not be your first decision.
sections.body:
Your AI builds what you ask for. But the result still feels generic, and another prompt doesn’t quite fix it.

What’s often missing is a clear direction: what the product should do, how it should feel, and which references to learn from.

Stage guides you through a clear design process, so you can turn your idea into a product people love using.

items.question: Is Stage Mac only?
items.answer: Yes, Stage is a native macOS app.

items.question: Does Stage design for me?
items.answer: No, Stage does not produce finished designs or high-fidelity screens. It helps you work through the research, decisions, direction and structure that your coding agent builds from.

items.question: Which AI tools does the export work with?
items.answer: Stage exports plain Markdown for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent that can read it. AGENTS.md explains the folder and the reading order.

items.question: Do I need Cursor or Claude Code to get value from Stage?
items.answer: You can read and use the research, strategy and specifications yourself. A coding agent is where you continue when you want to turn that work into a build.

items.question: Can I use my own component library?
items.answer: Yes. Import your own component library from GitHub, or install skills and component libraries from the Stage marketplace in one click. Add your selections to the brief so your coding agent uses them from the first build.

editorialNotes: The user requested hyphens throughout, including the previously locked hero subheadline.
Navigation, buttons, prices, file names and process nodes use ordinary UI labels. New prose and headings use full sentences.
No 90-second video was supplied, so the secondary hero CTA is omitted.
Proof remains TBD in this document and is excluded from the visitor page.

The real returned Research screenshots, a matched moodboard-to-style-guide example and a real export opened in Claude Code are still needed to meet the brief's evidence requirements. An illustrative composition must not be presented as those real examples.
Only AGENTS.md has a verified filename. Other document labels describe their contents; do not imply that an illustrative file naming scheme is an inspected export.
Download, login, contact, legal and social destinations were not supplied. The CTA copy is ready, but live destinations remain an integration dependency.
The roughly 3,000 reference-screen count and all prices are supplied product facts from the brief, not newly researched claims.
The six website sections now describe Research, Moodboard, Flows, Skills, Export and Integrations. This is a marketing-page grouping, not a replacement app pipeline.
Strategy and Wireframes remain real app stages and remain named in the export contents.
The hero and all other copy remain unchanged by this asset.
Studio changes to $99 per month. No seat-count, feature or Solo-price change is implied.
Use the new component-library question within the existing total of five FAQs. The root implementation chooses the replaced question.

MCP lets connected AI tools take actions directly in Stage. The user confirmed Claude, Codex, VS Code and other MCP-compatible tools, connection through a command, and release planned for the website launch. No exact command or individual actions have been supplied.
The user has specified that the chosen design skill and component library travel in the export. The exact representation and filenames were not supplied, so this copy does not invent them.

The Skills infographic is a website illustration based on the supplied product screens, using Design Taste and shadcn/ui as examples. Installation and adding selections to the brief are shown as distinct steps. It does not install or enable anything.
Real Research, moodboard and export evidence is still required before illustrative visuals can be treated as product proof.

The supplied integrations screenshot confirms Claude and Codex for research, strategy and generation; Figma for design export and handoff; Paper for local design canvas export; Notion for document export and review; and Google Sheets for importing project and onboarding data. ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code cards describe the previously confirmed MCP app actions. Account details from the screenshot are not used.
